ideas.pitch: A multilingual local-first voice agent using lightweight LLMs for offline symptom checking and health outbreak triage in rural Maharashtra.
ideas.title: RuralMed-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with grassroots social impact and leverages patterns from regional health communication success stories.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first computer vision mobile web application that detects early-stage crop diseases in regional staple crops using optimized mobile models.
ideas.title: AgriCrop-Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles an agrarian economic problem highly relevant to the Pune region, ensuring high relevance and user impact score.

ideas.pitch: A structured knowledge-base and indexing agent for academic departments to automatically turn messy lecture recordings and PDFs into queryable study graphs.
ideas.title: CampusScribe-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly benefits university departments and engineering students, making it instantly relatable to the college organizing committee and judges.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic public transit and carpooling coordination engine optimized for reducing local carbon emissions and student commuting friction in Tathawade.
ideas.title: EcoRoute-Pune
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines measurable economic and environmental impact with a hyper-local geographical focus that judges can instantly test.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered inventory and demand-forecast dashboard for university mess halls to minimize food waste using predictive analytics on attendance.
ideas.title: SmartMess-WasteAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete, quantifiable cost savings and environmental benefits that score exceptionally high on feasibility and scalability criteria.
